sentences.text: The Ontario royal commission identified that workers who installed or removed sprayed or pipe and boiler insulation containing asbestos without taking precautions for their own safety were exposed to high levels of asbestos fibres in the air.

The commission noted that the death of a school maintenance worker, Mr. Clifton Grant, a carpenter, as a result of an asbestos-related disease, led in part to the public pressure which resulted in the establishment of the Commission and the provincial programme for controlling asbestos exposure in schools.
The commission identified exposure of occupants and workers to asbestos fibres in buildings as a major problem area of asbestos exposure in Ontario.
